identity.production_end_note: No production-start/end date is asserted; the model is listed on the live current BAVARIA CRUISER LINE range as of BAV-1's retrieval on 2026-09-01. No epoch boundary is invented from the model name alone.

configuration_space_complete_basis: BAV-1's 'Technical data' table lists exactly two named draught rows ('Draught standard' and 'Draught option') alongside one ballast/displacement figure each. No source states this is the complete factory-relevant configuration space (e.g. rig-only options, regional variants unrelated to draught). configuration_space_complete is left False per the same discipline SLICE-0037 applied to the Oceanis 30.1's three named ballast options: the number of discovered named options is never itself treated as proof of completeness.
self_authorization_boundary_note: This file is a retained, editable research artifact, not a truth-authorizing one. scripts/search_seed_corpus_wave1.py's shared independent admission oracle (BAVARIA_ORACLE) independently re-derives design_id, configuration_space_complete, the exact configuration_id/named_variant_id set, and every field's exact value/evidence_refs/scope/direct_or_derived against hardcoded, code-side-only expectations before this file's content is permitted to become Search input -- it never trusts this file's own claims about itself, mirroring SLICE-0037 Required Behavior A.

configurations.configuration_basis: BAV-1's 'Technical data' table row 'Draught standard 2,04 m', the design's factory-default keel/ballast configuration (paired with 'Ballast standard 1.363 kg' / 'Displacement standard 5.298 kg' on the same row set). `configuration_evidence_refs` is machine-checked identity evidence; `configuration_basis` remains human-readable audit prose only and is never itself the truth-authorizing mechanism.

loa_m.scope: BAV-1's unqualified 'Length over all 9,99 m' row (design-wide hull-mold dimension; does not vary by draught option). Distinct from the same table's separately labelled 'Length over all (incl. bowsprit) 10,67 m' row, which is not used here -- the unqualified 'Length over all' is the literal, direct match for the generic loa_m field.

beam_m.scope: BAV-1's 'Beam of hull 3,42 m' (design-wide hull-mold dimension; does not vary by draught option).

draft_max_m.scope: BAV-1's 'Technical data' table row 'Draught standard 2,04 m', bound specifically to this factory-default configuration. BAV-1 separately captions a VPP (velocity prediction program) performance chart with 'deep keel 2.02 m'; this narrative/marketing caption figure is NOT used as this configuration's value (it is not on the same side of any Q1/Q2/Q10 threshold as 2.04 m either way, so the discrepancy is immaterial to every locked query, but the structured 'Technical data' table figure is preferred as the more literal, direct source statement over marketing-caption prose, consistent with the Oceanis 30.1 pilot's preference for structured spec-table facts).

configurations.configuration_basis: BAV-1's 'Technical data' table row 'Draught option 1,58 m', the factory-offered shoal-draught alternative to the standard configuration. `configuration_evidence_refs` is machine-checked identity evidence; `configuration_basis` remains human-readable audit prose only.
